0022600134.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-1, 1st in the Southeast, 3rd in the East, on a two-game winning streak) visit the Detroit Pistons (3-1, 1st in the Central, 1st in the East, coming off a loss) in the fifth game of the Hornets' season. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 118-100 in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
